changelog: Vortex v5.5.29: Check Accounts no longer deletes your accounts - the batch checker used to wait a flat seven seconds and then delete any row it hadn't seen sign in, which expired before the automated login had even typed the password. It now follows the login through to Riot's real response, tells a genuine credential rejection apart from a retryable window/automation hiccup, and never removes an account (anything unconfirmed is kept for retry or for you to fix in Edit Account). Elevated Riot Client is now handled: when Vortex isn't also running as administrator the login used to just stall, so it now detects that mismatch and offers "Restart as administrator" (one UAC prompt). The insta-lock picker greys out agents the signed-in account doesn't own. Rebuilt match history and scoreboard with map splash art, role badges, Match/Team MVP tags, a headshot column, a round timeline and de-duplicated player rows. Plus: the dashboard slides in from the side instead of the full-screen wipe, loader spinners on the check buttons, and the Replication mode entry was removed.
